---
title: "The Agents Zoo"
subtitle: "Vetted Specifications for Agentic ML Systems, Deliberation Profiles, and Harnesses"
---

The Agents Zoo is the authoritative registry for autonomous agent system configurations in `mlsysim`.
It captures operational execution boundaries, context window allocations, deliberation search profiles,
and tool-use execution environments across Volume III (Agentic ML Systems).

::: {.callout-tip}
## How to use this page
Reference these profiles when designing multi-turn agent systems, budgeting KV-cache memory for
deliberation trees, sizing multi-agent worker fleets, or evaluating tool-use sandbox latency.
Load any agent architecture directly in Python: `agent = mlsysim.Agents.Deliberation.TreeSearch`.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import mlsysim

_swe = mlsysim.Agents.Coding.SWE_Bench_Runner
_swe_local = mlsysim.Agents.Coding.SWE_Bench_Workstation
_tree = mlsysim.Agents.Deliberation.TreeSearch
_fleet = mlsysim.Agents.MultiAgent.SupervisorWorker
_voice = mlsysim.Agents.Interactive.StreamingVoice

_swe_boot_ms = _swe.sandbox_startup_latency.to("ms").magnitude
_swe_restore_ms = _swe.sandbox_snapshot_restore_latency.to("ms").magnitude
_swe_mem_mib = _swe.sandbox_memory_footprint.to("MiB").magnitude
_swe_cores = _swe.serving_node.host_cpu_cores
_swe_ctx_k = _swe.context_window.magnitude / 1000
_swe_steps = _swe.max_trajectory_steps

_local_cores = _swe_local.serving_node.host_cpu_cores
_local_cap_gib = _swe_local.serving_node.accelerator.memory.capacity.to("GiB").magnitude
_local_bw_gbs = _swe_local.serving_node.accelerator.memory.bandwidth.to("GB/s").magnitude

_tree_branches = _tree.deliberation_branches
_tree_verifier = _tree.verifier_cost_ratio
_fleet_beta = _fleet.coordination_overhead_beta
_voice_ctx_k = _voice.context_window.magnitude / 1000
_voice_wm_k = _voice.working_memory.magnitude / 1000

def auto_scale_tokens(q):
    if q is None:
        return "---"
    return f"{q.magnitude:,.0f} tokens"

def auto_scale_latency(q):
    if q is None:
        return "---"
    ms_val = q.to('ms').magnitude
    return f"{ms_val:,.1f} ms"

def auto_scale_bytes(q):
    if q is None:
        return "---"
    mib_val = q.to('MiB').magnitude
    return f"{mib_val:,.0f} MiB"

print("### Agent Architectures & Execution Harnesses")
print("| Agent Profile | Paradigm | Context Window | Working Memory | Sandbox Boot | Snapshot Restore | Sandbox Footprint | Reference Model | Serving Node |")
print("|:---|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---|:---|")

categories = [
    ("Coding", getattr(mlsysim.Agents, "Coding", None)),
    ("Deliberation", getattr(mlsysim.Agents, "Deliberation", None)),
    ("MultiAgent", getattr(mlsysim.Agents, "MultiAgent", None)),
    ("Interactive", getattr(mlsysim.Agents, "Interactive", None)),
]

for cat_name, cat_obj in categories:
    if not cat_obj:
        continue
    for attr_name in sorted(dir(cat_obj)):
        if attr_name.startswith("_"):
            continue
        item = getattr(cat_obj, attr_name)
        if hasattr(item, "name") and hasattr(item, "context_window"):
            ctx = auto_scale_tokens(item.context_window)
            wm = auto_scale_tokens(item.working_memory)
            boot = auto_scale_latency(item.sandbox_startup_latency)
            restore = auto_scale_latency(item.sandbox_snapshot_restore_latency)
            mem = auto_scale_bytes(item.sandbox_memory_footprint)
            model = item.reference_model.name if item.reference_model else "---"
            node = item.serving_node.name if item.serving_node else "---"
            print(f"| **{item.name}** | {item.paradigm} | {ctx} | {wm} | {boot} | {restore} | {mem} | {model} | {node} |")

print("\n")
```

## Agentic Systems Architecture (Volume III)

Agent systems turn foundation models from static advisory oracles into active processors:

1. **Coding & Software Engineering Agents (`Agents.Coding.SWE_Bench_Runner`)**
   - ReAct and Plan-and-Solve execution patterns executing inside isolated, hermetic microVM sandboxes (Firecracker CoW fork latency $\le `{python} f"{_swe_boot_ms:.0f}"`\text{ ms}$, snapshot restore $\le `{python} f"{_swe_restore_ms:.0f}"`\text{ ms}$, $`{python} f"{_swe_mem_mib:.0f}"`\text{ MiB}$ memory footprint).
   - Served on high-density execution nodes (`Systems.Nodes.HGX_H100_EPYC`) with `{python} f"{_swe_cores}"` AMD EPYC CPU cores (`{python} _swe.serving_node.host_cpu`) to prevent host core contention during parallel microVM execution.
   - Bounded by token context limits ($`{python} f"{_swe_ctx_k:.0f}"`\text{k}$ tokens) and deterministic AST / unit-test verification oracles across trajectory steps ($\le `{python} f"{_swe_steps}"`$ steps).
2. **Developer Workstation Baseline (`Agents.Coding.SWE_Bench_Workstation`)**
   - Local unified memory developer baseline running on `Systems.Nodes.Workstation_M3Max` (`{python} f"{_local_cores}"`-core CPU, `{python} f"{_local_cap_gib:.0f}"` GiB unified LPDDR5X @ `{python} f"{_local_bw_gbs:.0f}"` GB/s) paired with `Models.Language.Llama3_8B` (`{python} _swe_local.reference_model.name`).
3. **Reference Platforms (`Agents.Platforms` / `AgentPlatforms`)**
   - Canonical whole-system envelopes binding compute nodes, foundation models, and sandboxes: `Agents.Platforms.Cloud_DGX_H100` for enterprise clusters and `Agents.Platforms.Workstation_Apple` for local developer iteration.
4. **Deliberative Reasoning Agents (`Agents.Deliberation.TreeSearch`)**
   - Allocates test-time inference compute through tree search / MCTS ($N=`{python} f"{_tree_branches}"`$ branches) scored by Process Reward Models (PRMs) with verifier cost ratio $`{python} f"{_tree_verifier:.2f}"`$.
   - Multiplies branch capacity via PagedAttention Copy-on-Write KV-cache page sharing across shared prompt prefixes.
5. **Multi-Agent Fleets (`Agents.MultiAgent.SupervisorWorker`)**
   - Coordinates specialized workers (Coder, Reviewer, Tester) via asynchronous message buses with bounded coordination overhead ($\beta = `{python} f"{_fleet_beta:.3f}"`$).
6. **Real-Time Interactive Agents (`Agents.Interactive.StreamingVoice`)**
   - Streaming speech-to-speech pipelines with $`{python} f"{_voice_ctx_k:.0f}"`\text{k}$-token context window and $`{python} f"{_voice_wm_k:.0f}"`\text{k}$-token active working memory bound by human conversational latency budgets.

## Python Access

```{python}
#| echo: true
import mlsysim

# Load agent architectures and canonical platforms
swe = mlsysim.Agents.Coding.SWE_Bench_Runner
swe_local = mlsysim.Agents.Coding.SWE_Bench_Workstation
cloud_platform = mlsysim.Agents.Platforms.Cloud_DGX_H100

# Access vetted parameters
print(f"Context window:   {swe.context_window:~P}")
print(f"Sandbox boot:     {swe.sandbox_startup_latency:~P}")
print(f"Snapshot restore: {swe.sandbox_snapshot_restore_latency:~P}")
print(f"Sandbox memory:   {swe.sandbox_memory_footprint:~P}")
print(f"Max steps:        {swe.max_trajectory_steps}")
print(f"Host CPU:         {swe.serving_node.host_cpu} ({swe.serving_node.host_cpu_cores} cores)")

# Deliberation and multi-agent coordination
tree = mlsysim.Agents.Deliberation.TreeSearch
fleet = mlsysim.Agents.MultiAgent.SupervisorWorker
print(f"Tree branches:    {tree.deliberation_branches}")
print(f"Coordination β:   {fleet.coordination_overhead_beta}")
```
